comparison.objective: Routes turbine seal segments around a ring groove with inter-arm transfer; candidate fractures and recovers four installed HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Groove following and bimanual handoff differ from coaxial mandrel stabilization, controlled hammer impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Seal routing is the title-supported outcome; no rubric/spec thresholds are available. Candidate requires four contact-driven fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual manipulation is generic; the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ.
